thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - GPU provisioning errors (aws-ap-southeast-2)
• severity: P1
• symptom: autoscaler repeatedly failing to create GPU instances; requests piling in queue
• pager: @maya

maya: hitting it. pulling autoscaler, cloud logs, and queue dashboards now

luca: seeing AWS errors: 
```
2026-03-15T06:11:02Z ERROR CreateFleet failed: InstanceLimitExceeded: Request would exceed On-Demand G4dn GPU instance limit for account 123456789012 in ap-southeast-2
Requested: 10, Available: 0
```

erin: region snapshot - GPU capacity: 0 free, requested pending nodes: 6, queue depth: 920, 5xx rate 6.4% over baseline. several pending spot requests marked "capacity-not-available"

maya: customer impact = partial -> basic hosted endpoints degraded in ap-southeast-2. marking CS notify.

samir: quick note: noticed a burst from ci-eval-job-7 in staging that spun up many GPU spot instances earlier; maybe leaked or didn't terminate cleanly

maya: mitigation plan: 1) throttle internal CI/eval jobs 2) reroute non-SLA traffic to us-west-2 3) enable reduced-size fallback model for best-effort requests 4) open AWS support case for account-level quota review

deploy-bot: routing policy apply v2026-03-15-02 - 40% -> us-west-2, 55% -> eu-central-1, 5% -> ap-southeast-2-canary :white_check_mark:

luca: opening AWS support case: 987654321 - flagged as "Urgent: production blocked". asked for account-level GPU instance limit increase and account-level hard cap clarification

cs-bot: notifying CS channel and creating alert for affected tenants (tenant IDs: t-acme, t-bravo). CS will draft customer message.

erin: throttle rule pushed for CI evals: label(ci-eval)=true -> max-gpus=2; killing known runaway eval fleet now

maya: enabling fallback model redwood-micro-q2 for requests that are not pinned. pushing routing rules now

luca: AWS replied: initial ack, requesting list of recent Fleet/LaunchTemplate IDs and CloudTrail traces. ETA 2-4 hours for quota decision unless escalated; we've requested an expedite

samir: cleaned up leaked spot instances from ci-eval-job-7; reclaimed ~12 GPUs across other regions but not ap-southeast-2 (these were in different AZs/accounts)

maya: after reroute + fallback, queue down 920 -> 310 in ~12 minutes. 5xx down to 1.8%. still seeing 3 pending provisioning attempts failing with InstanceLimitExceeded

erin: quick check - could this be an org-level hard cap vs per-project limit? if org-level, AWS might require billing/partner escalation. opening internal ops ticket to gather org-level counters

luca: added CloudTrail logs + autoscaler request IDs to AWS case. support asked for account root contact; pinging finance to approve emergency escalation

mike (infra-bot): auto-signal: added temporary alert mute for ap-southeast-2 noisy alarms to prevent alert fatigue until resolution

samir: note: one paying customer (zedware) had pinned endpoints in ap-southeast-2; we reached out to CS to offer temporary region migration guidance

maya: CS outbound to affected customers sent - included mitigation steps, not promising ETA. asked CS to enable client-side backoff and retry guidance

luca: metrics: queue 310 -> 140 after additional throttles and rerouting. p95 latency down to 4.1s. keeping a 30m window before declaring stable

erin: AWS case updated: support engineer says account-level quota is likely enforced due to previous emergency increases being denied last quarter; they requested a phone call with account owner. escalation path opened

maya: handoff: @luca you'll take on-call for next 40m. I'm switching to incident lead to coordinate CS/legal. logs: https://redwood.internal/metrics/1799998888

luca: taking handoff. targets: queue <200 and 5xx <1%

samir: re-checking autoscaler config - fallback behavior for regional failures didn't trigger because the autoscaler considered "InstanceLimitExceeded" as a transient API error; adjusting classifier to treat this as quota failure and auto-trigger fallback sooner

maya: good find. update routing to be more aggressive for quota errors

luca: after config change + aggressive fallback, queue 140 -> 40 in 9 minutes. 5xx 0.5%. pending provisioning attempts stopped (no new failures).

erin: finance responded to AWS request and authorized emergency escalation call; AWS scheduled call in 30m. added billing contact to case 987654321

maya: preparing incident summary for execs. assigning postmortem owner @erin. initial actions: auto-throttle internal evals, add org-level GPU headroom metric, treat account-level quota errors specially in autoscaler, improve customer communication templates

luca: handing back to maya at 1799999400 - queue stable 55m, 5xx <1% for 40m

maya: back on-call. will observe for 2h before close. thanks team.

incident-bot: UPDATE - status: mitigated via cross-region reroute + fallback + CI throttling. Follow-ups: postmortem required, track AWS case #987654321, implement autoscaler classifier change.

erin: postmortem plan: 24h draft, include timeline, root cause (CI leak + insufficient account headroom + autoscaler misclassification), remediation (headroom alerts, autoscaler classifier, CI quota guards), and customer comms template

maya: closing coordination for now. will update thread when postmortem is published. :pray:
